metadata.title: Veering triangulations of once-punctured torus bundles are unique
metadata.abstract: We show that each hyperbolic once-punctured torus bundle has exactly one veering triangulation. We also find manifolds for which the exact number of veering structures is known and is greater than one. Finally, we give new examples of manifolds without veering triangulations.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明双曲一次穿孔环面丛的 veering 三角剖分唯一，并研究其他流形中 veering 结构的数量。
techniques: 结构计数与非存在例子
analysis.breakthrough: 为该类环面丛给出精确唯一性，同时构造可确定多个结构或没有这种剖分的流形例子。
analysis.limitations: 唯一性只属于指定双曲环面丛类，其他例子正说明不能推广到所有双曲三维流形。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
